verses.text_uthmani: حمٓ

translations.text: Ha Mim
Haa Meem

verses.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

translations.text: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Almighty, the All Knowing,
Is kitaab ka nuzul Allah ki taraf se hai jo zabardast hai, sab kuch jaanne wala hai

verses.text_uthmani: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

translations.text: Forgiver of sins and Accepter of repentance, severe in punishment, infinite in bounty. There is no god but Him; to Him is the ultimate return.
Gunaah maaf karne wala aur tauba qabool karne wala hai, sakht saza dene wala aur bada sahib e fazal hai. Koi mabood uske siwa nahin, usi ki taraf sabko palatna hai

verses.text_uthmani: مَا يُجَـٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ

translations.text: It is only the disbelievers who dispute God’s revelations. [Prophet], do not be dazzled by their movements back and forth across the land.
Allah ki aayat mein jhagde nahin karte magar sirf woh log jinhon ne kufr kiya hai. Iske baad duniya ke mulkon mein unki chalat phirat tumhein kisi dhoke mein na daale

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَـٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

translations.text: Before them the people of Noah rejected the truth and so did those who formed opposition after them: every community schemed to destroy its messenger and strove to refute truth with falsehood; but it was I who destroyed them. How terrible My punishment was!

Insey pehle Nooh ki qaum bhi jhutla chuki hai, aur uske baad bahut se dusre jatthon (groups) ne bhi yeh kaam kiya hai. Har qaum apne Rasool par jhapti taa-ke usey giraftar karey, un sab ne baatil ke hatyaaron se haqq ko neecha dikhane ki koshish ki. Magar aakhir e kaar maine unko pakad liya, phir dekhlo ke meri saza kaisi sakht thi

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

translations.text: In this way your Lord’s sentence was passed against the disbelievers that they would be the inhabitants of the Fire.
Isi tarah tere Rubb ka yeh faisla bhi un sab logon par chaspan ho chukka hai jo kufr ke murtakib huey hain ke woh wasil-ba-jahannum honay waley hain

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

translations.text: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those who surround it celebrate the praise of their Lord and have faith in Him. They beg forgiveness for the believers: ‘Our Lord, You embrace all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who turn to You and follow Your path. Save them from the pains of Hell

Arsh e ilahi ke haamil farishtey aur woh jo arsh ke gird o pesh haazir rehte hain, sab apne Rubb ki hamd ke saath uski tasbeeh kar rahey hain, woh uspar imaan rakhte hain aur imaan laney walon ke haqq mein dua e magfirat karte hain, woh kehte hain : “Aey hamare Rubb, tu apni rehmat aur apne ilm ke saath har cheez par chaya hua hai, pas maaf karde aur azaab e dozakh se bacha ley un logon ko jinhon ne tauba ki hai aur tera raasta ikhtiyar karliya hai

verses.text_uthmani: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

translations.text: and admit them, Lord, to the lasting Gardens You have promised to them, together with their righteous ancestors, spouses, and offspring: You alone are the Almighty, the All Wise.

Aey hamare Rubb, aur daakhil kar unko hamesha rehne wali un jannaton mein jinka tu ne unsey waada kiya hai, aur unke waldain aur biwiyon aur aulad mein se jo saleh (righteous) hon (unko bhi wahan unke saath pahuncha de). Tu bila shubah qadir e multaq (Most Mighty) aur hakeem(most wise) hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُۥ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

translations.text: Protect them from all evil deeds: those You protect on that Day from [the punishment for] evil deeds will receive Your mercy- that is the supreme triumph.’
Aur bacha de unko buraiyon se. Jisko tu nay qayamat ke din buraiyon se bacha diya uspar tu nay bada reham kiya. Yahi badi kamiyabi hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ

translations.text: But those who disbelieved will be told, ‘When you were called to the faith and rejected it, God’s disgust with you was even greater then than the self-disgust you feel [today].’

Jin logon ne kufr kiya hai, qayamat ke roz unko pukaar kar kaha jayega “Aaj tumhein jitna shadeed gussa apne upar aa raha hai , Allah tumpar ussey zyada gazabnaak us waqt hota tha jab tumhein imaan ki taraf bulaya jata tha aur tum kufr karte thay”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَٱعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ

translations.text: They will say, ‘Our Lord, twice You have caused us to be lifeless and twice You have brought us to life. Now we recognize our sins. Is there any way out?’
Woh kahenge “Aey hamare Rubb, tu nay waqayi humein do dafa maut aur do dafa zindagi dedi. Ab hum apne kasooron ka aitraaf karte hain.Kya ab yahan se nikalne ki bhi koi sabeel hai?”

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ ۚ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ

translations.text: [They will be told], ‘This is all because when God alone was invoked you rejected this, yet when others were associated with Him you believed [in them].’ Judgement belongs to God the Most High, the Most Great.

(jawab milega) “yeh halat jismein tum mubtala ho, is wajah se hai ke jab akele Allah ki taraf bulaya jata tha to tum manne se inkar kar detay thay aur jab uske saath dusron ko milaya jata tha to tum maan letay thay. Ab faisla Allah buzurg o bartar ke haath hai”

verses.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقًا ۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ

translations.text: It is He who shows you [people] His signs and sends water down from the sky to sustain you, though only those who turn to God will take heed.

Wahi hai jo tumko apni nishaniyan dikhata hai aur aasmaan se tumhare liye rizq naazil karta hai, magar ( in nihsaniyon ke mushahidey se)sabaq sirf wahi shaks leta hai jo Allah ki taraf rujoo karne wala ho

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: So call upon God and dedicate your religion to Him alone, however hateful this may be to the disbelievers:
(pas aey rujoo karne walon) Allah hi ko pukaro apne deen ko uske liye khaalis karke, khwah tumhara yeh fail(kaam/amal) kaafiron ko kitna hi nagawaar ho

verses.text_uthmani: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَـٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ

translations.text: He is exalted in rank, the Lord of the Throne. He sends revelations with His teachings to whichever of His servants He will, in order to warn of the Day of Meeting,
Woh buland darajon wala, Maalik e Arsh hai apne bandon mein se jispar chahta hai apne hukum se rooh nazil kar deta hai taa-ke woh mulaqat ke din se khabardar karde

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُم بَـٰرِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌ ۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ

translations.text: the Day when they will come out and nothing about them will be concealed from God. ‘Who has control today?’ ‘God, the One, the All Powerful.

Woh din jabke sab log bay purdah hongey, Allah se unki koi baat bhi chupi hui na hogi ( us roz pukar kar poochca jayega) aaj baadshahi kiski hai? (saara aalam pukar utthega) Allah waahid-e-qahhar (the One the Overpowering) ki

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

translations.text: Today each soul will be rewarded for whatever it has done; today no injustice will be done. God is swift in reckoning.’
(Kaha jayega) aaj har mutanaffis ko us kamayi ka badla diya jayega jo usne ki thi. Aaj kisi par koi zulm na hoga aur Allah hisaab lene mein bahut teiz hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلْحَنَاجِرِ كَـٰظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ

translations.text: Warn them [Prophet] of the ever-approaching Day, when hearts are at throats, choking them. The evildoer will have no friends, nor any intercessor to be heeded.

(Aey Nabi) dara do in logon ko usdin se jo qareeb aa laga hai, jab kalijey (livers) mooh ko aa rahe hongey aur log chup chaap gham ke ghoont peay khaday hongey. Zaalimon ka na koi mushfiq dost hoga aur na koi shafee jiski baat maani jaye

verses.text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ

translations.text: God is aware of the most furtive of glances, and of all that hearts conceal:
Allah nigahon ki chori tak se waaqif hai aur woh raaz tak jaanta hai jo seeno ne chupa rakhe hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

translations.text: God will judge with truth, while those they invoke besides Him will not judge at all. God is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.

Aur Allah theek theek bay-laag(with justice) faisla karega .Rahey woh jinko ( yeh mushrikeen) Allah ko chodh kar pukarte hain, woh kisi cheez ka bhi faisla karne waley nahin hain. Bila shubah Allah hi sabkuch sunney aur dekhne wala hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ

translations.text: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how those who lived before them met their end? They were stronger than them and made a more impressive mark on the land, yet God destroyed them for their sins- they had no one to defend them against Him-

Kya yeh log kabhi zameen mein chaley phiray nahin hain ke inhein un logon ka anjaam nazar aata jo insey pehle guzar chuke hain? Woh insey zyada taaqatwar thay aur insey zyada zabardast aasaar zameen mein chodh gaye hain. Magar Allah ne unke gunahon par unhein pakad liya aur unko Allah se bachane wala koi na tha

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَكَفَرُوا۟ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ

translations.text: because messengers repeatedly came to them with clear signs and still they rejected them. God destroyed them: He is truly full of strength, severe in punishment.
Yeh unka anjaam is liye hua ke unke paas unke

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: We sent Moses with Our signs and clear authority
Hum ne Moosa ko apni nishaniyon aur numayan sanad-e-ma’muriyat ke saath bheja.

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ وَقَـٰرُونَ فَقَالُوا۟ سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ

translations.text: to Pharaoh, Haman, and Korah and they said, ‘Sorcerer! Liar!’
Firoun aur Haaman aur Qaroon ki taraf apni nishaniyon aur numaya sanad-e-maamoriyat ke saath bheja. Magar unhon ne kaha “ saahir(jaadugar) hai, kazzab(jhoota) hai”

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَبْنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسْتَحْيُوا۟ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ

translations.text: When he brought the truth to them from Us, they said, ‘Kill the sons of those who believe with him; spare only their women’- the scheming of those who reject the truth can only go wrong-

Phir jab woh hamari taraf se haqq unke saamne ley aaya to unhon ne kaha “jo log imaan laa kar iske saath shamil huey hain in sabke ladkon ko qatal karo aur ladkiyon ko jeeta (zinda) chodh do”. Magar kaafiron ki chaal akarat (vain) hi gayi

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِىٓ أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُۥٓ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَن يُظْهِرَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْفَسَادَ

translations.text: and Pharaoh said, ‘Leave me to kill Moses- let him call upon his Lord!- for I fear he may cause you to change your religion, or spread disorder in the land.’

Ek roz Firoun ne apne darbariyon se kaha “chodo mujhey main is Moosa ko qatal kiye deta hoon, aur pukar dekhe yeh apne Rubb ko.Mujhey andesha hai ke yeh tumhara deen badal daalega, ya mulk mein fasaad barpa karega”

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

translations.text: Moses said, ‘I seek refuge with my Lord and yours from every tyrant who refuses to believe in the Day of Reckoning.’
Moosa ne kaha “maine to har us mutakabbir (ghamandi) ke muqable mein jo yaum ul hisaab par imaan nahin rakhta apne Rubb aur tumhare Rubb ki panaah ley li hai”

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَـٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّىَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ كَـٰذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى يَعِدُكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ

translations.text: A secret believer from Pharaoh’s family said, ‘How can you kill a man just for saying, “My Lord is God”? He has brought you clear signs from your Lord- if he is a liar, on his own head be it- and if he is truthful, then at least some of what he has threatened will happen to you. God does not guide any rebellious, outrageous liar.

Is mauqe par aale Firoun mein se ek momin shaks, jo apna imaan chupaye huey tha, bol utha: “Kya tum ek shaks ko sirf is bina par qatal kardoge ke woh kehta hai mera Rubb Allah hai? Halaanke woh tumhare Rubb ki taraf se tumhare paas bayyinat le aaya, agar woh jhoota hai to uska jhoot khud usi par palat padega, lekin agar woh saccha hai to jin haulnaak nataij ka woh tumko khauff dilata hai unmein se kuch to tumpar zaroor hi aa jayenge. Allah kisi aise shaks ko hidayat nahin deta jo hadd se guzar janey wala aur kazzab (jhoota) ho

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ظَـٰهِرِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأْسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَا ۚ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ

translations.text: My people, as masters in the land you have the power today, but who will help us against God’s might if it comes upon us?’ But Pharaoh said, ‘I have told you what I think; I am guiding you along the right path.’

Aey meri qaum ke logon! Aaj tumhein baadshahi hasil hai aur zameen mein tum gaalib ho, lekin agar khuda ka azaab humpar aa gaya to phir kaun hai jo hamari madad kar sakega?” Firoun ne kaha “Main to tum logon ko wahi rai dey raha hoon jo mujhey munasib nazar aati hai aur main usi raaste ki taraf tumhari rehnumayi karta hoon jo theek hai”

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ

translations.text: The believer said, ‘My people, I fear your fate will be the fate of those others who opposed [their prophets]:
Woh shaks jo imaan laaya tha usne kaha “Aey meri qaum ke logon, Mujhey khauf hai ke kahin tumpar bhi woh din na aa jaaye jo issey pehle bahut se jatthon (parties) par aa chuka hai

verses.text_uthmani: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ

translations.text: the fate of the people of Noah, Ad, Thamud, and those who came after them- God never wills injustice on His creatures.
Jaisa din qaum e Nooh aur Aad aur Samood, aur unke baad waali qaumon par aaya tha. Aur yeh haqeeqat hai ke Allah apne bandon par zulm ka koi irada nahin rakhta

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ

translations.text: My people, I fear for you on the Day you will cry out to one another,
Aey Qaum, mujhey darr hai ke kahin tumpar fariyad o fugaan ka din (day of calling) na aa jaaye

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ

translations.text: the Day you will turn tail and flee with no one to defend you from God! Whoever God leaves to stray will have no one to guide him.
Jab tum ek dusre ko pukaroge aur bhaagay bhaagay phirogey, magar us waqt Allah se bachane wala koi na hoga.Sach yeh hai ke jisey Allah bhatka dey usey phir koi raasta dikhane wala nahin hota

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابٌ

translations.text: Joseph came to you before with clear signs, but you never ceased to doubt the message he brought you. When he died, you said, “God will not send another messenger.”’ In this way God leaves the doubting rebels to stray-

Issey pehle Yusuf tumhare paas bayyinat lekar aaye thay magar tum unki layi hui taleem ki taraf se shakk hi mein paday rahey. Phir jab unka inteqal ho gaya to tumne kaha ab unke baad Allah koi Rasool hargiz na bhejega.” Isi taraah Allah un sab logon ko gumraahi mein daal deta hai jo hadd se guzarne waale aur shakki(doubting) hotey hain

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَـٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۖ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ

translations.text: those who dispute God’s messages, with no authority given to them, are doing something that is loathed by God and by those who believe. In this way God seals up the heart of every arrogant tyrant.

Aur Allah ki aayat mein jhagade karte hain bagair iske ke unke paas koi sanad ya daleel aayi ho.Yeh rawayya Allah aur imaan laney walon ke nazdeek sakht mabguz (na-pasand) hai.Isi tarah Allah har mutakabbir o Jabbar ke dil par thappa laga deta hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَـٰهَـٰمَـٰنُ ٱبْنِ لِى صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَبْلُغُ ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبَ

translations.text: Pharaoh said, ‘Haman, build me a tall tower so that I may reach the ropes that lead
Firoun ne kaha “Aey Haamaan, mere liye ek buland imarat bana taa-ke main raaston tak pahuch sakun

verses.text_uthmani: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍ

translations.text: to the heavens to look for this God of Moses. I am convinced that he is lying.’ In this way the evil of Pharaoh’s deed was made alluring to him and he was barred from the right path- his scheming led only to ruin.

Aasmaano ke raaston tak, aur Moosa ke khuda ko jhaank kar dekhun.Mujhey to yeh Moosa jhoota hi maloom hota hai.” Is tarah Firoun ke liye uski badh-amali khushnuma bana di gayi aur woh raah e raast se roak diya gaya. Firoun ki saari chaalbaazi (uski apni) tabahi ke raaste hi mein sarf (use/istemal) hui

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ

translations.text: The believer said, ‘My people, follow me! I will guide you to the right path.
Woh shaks jo imaan laya tha bola “ Aey meri qaum ke logon, meri baat maano, main tumhein saheeh raasta batata hoon

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَتَـٰعٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ ٱلْقَرَارِ

translations.text: My people, the life of this world is only a brief enjoyment; it is the Hereafter that is the lasting home.
Aey qaum, yeh duniya ki zindagi to chand roza hai, hamesha ke liye qayam (permanent abode) ki jagah aakhirat hi hai

verses.text_uthmani: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

translations.text: Whoever does evil will be repaid with its like; whoever does good and believes, be it a man or a woman, will enter Paradise and be provided for without measure.

Jo burayi karega usko utna hi badla milega jitni usne burayi ki hogi aur jo neik amal karega, khwah woh mard ho ya aurat, bashart ye ke ho woh momin, aise sab log jannat mein daakhil hongey jahan unko bay hisaab rizq diya jayega

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَـٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ

translations.text: My people, why do I call you to salvation when you call me to the Fire?
Aey qaum, aakhir yeh kya maajra hai ke mai to tum logon ko nijaat (salvation) ki taraf bulata hoon aur tumlog mujhey aag ki taraf dawat detey ho

verses.text_uthmani: تَدْعُونَنِى لِأَكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا۠ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرِ

translations.text: You call me to disbelieve in God and to associate with Him things of which I have no knowledge; I call you to the Mighty, the Forgiving One.

Tum mujhey is baat ki dawat detey ho ke main Allah se kufr karoon aur uske saath un hastiyon ko shareek thehraun jinhein main nahin jaanta Halaanke main tumhein us zabardast magfirat karne wale khuda ki taraf bula raha hoon

verses.text_uthmani: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَعْوَةٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ

translations.text: There is no doubt that what you call me to serve is not fit to be invoked either in this world or the Hereafter: our return is to God alone, and it will be the rebels who will inhabit the Fire.

Nahin, haqq yeh hai aur iske khilaf nahin ho sakta ke jinki taraf tum mujhey bula rahey ho unke liye na duniya mein koi dawat hai na aakhirat mein, aur hum sabko palatna Allah hi ki taraf hai, aur hadd se guzarne waley aag mein janey waley hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ

translations.text: [One Day] you will remember what I am saying to you now, so I commit my case to God: God is well aware of His servants.’
Aaj jo kuch main keh raha hoon , anqareeb woh waqt aayega jab tum usey yaad karogey aur apna maamla main Allah ke supurd karta hoon, woh apne bandon ka nigehbaan hai”

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ

translations.text: So God saved him from the harm they planned. A terrible punishment engulfed Pharaoh’s people;
Aakhir e kaar un logon ne jo buri se buri chalein us momin ke khilaf chalin, Allah ne un sabse usko bacha liya, aur Firoun ke saathi khud badtareen azaab ke pher mein aa gaye

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلْعَذَابِ

translations.text: they will be brought before the Fire morning and evening. On the Day the Hour comes, it will be said, ‘Throw Pharaoh’s people into the worst torment.’
Dozakh ki aag hai jiske saamney subah o shaam woh pesh kiye jaate hain, aur jab qayamat ki ghadi aa jayegi to hukum hoga ke aale Firoun ko shadeed-tarr azaab mein daakhil karo

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَـٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ

translations.text: In the Fire they will quarrel with one another: the weak will say to the haughty, ‘We were your followers, so can you now relieve us from some share of the Fire?’

Phir zara khayal karo us waqt ka jab yeh log dozakh mein ek dusre se jhagad rahey hongey. Duniya mein jo log kamzoar thay woh badey ban-ney walon se kahenge ke “hum tumhare tabey(followers) thay, ab kya yahan tum naar-e-jahannum (hell fire) ki takleef ke kuch hissey se humko bacha logey

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ

translations.text: but they will say, ‘We are all in this together. God has judged between His creatures.’
Woh badey bannay waley jawab dengey “ hum sab yahan ek haal mein hain,aur Allah bandon ke darmiyan faisla kar chuka hai”

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ

translations.text: Those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, ‘Ask your Lord to lessen our suffering for one day,’
Phir yeh dozakh mein padey huey log jahannum ke ahal-kaaroon (keepers of Hell) se kahenge “ Apne Rubb se dua karo ke hamare azaab mein bas ek din ki takhfif karde”

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ ۚ قَالُوا۟ فَٱدْعُوا۟ ۗ وَمَا دُعَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ

translations.text: but they will say, ‘Did your messengers not come to you with clear evidence of the truth?’ They will say, ‘Yes they did,’ and the keeper will say, ‘You can plead, then, but the pleas of disbelievers will always be in vain.’

Woh poochenge “kya tumhare paas tumhare Rasool bayyinaat (clear proofs) lekar nahin aatey rahey thay?” woh kahenge “haan” jahannum ke ahalkar bolenge: “phir tum hi dua karo, aur kafiron ki dua akarat (vain) hi janey wali hai.”

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْأَشْهَـٰدُ

translations.text: We support Our messengers and the believers, in the present life and on the Day when witnesses arise.
Yaqeen jaano ke hum apne Rasoolon aur imaan laney walon ki madad is duniya ki zindagi mein bhi laaziman karte hain, aur us roz bhi karenge jab gawaah khade hongey

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ

translations.text: On the Day when excuses will not profit the evildoers, their fate will be rejection and they will have the worst of homes.
Jab zaalimon ko unki maazrat(excuses) kuch bhi faiyda na degi aur unpar laanat padegi aur badhtareen thikana unke hissay mein aayega

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ

translations.text: We gave Moses guidance and passed down the Scripture to the Children of Israel,
Aakhir dekhlo ke Moosa ki humne rehmumayi ki aur bani Israel ko us kitaab ka waris bana diya

verses.text_uthmani: هُدًى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

translations.text: as a guide and a reminder to people of understanding.
Jo aqal o daanish rakhne walon ke liye hidayat o naseehat hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَـٰرِ

translations.text: So be patient, Prophet, for what God has promised is sure to come. Ask forgiveness for your sins; praise your Lord morning and evening.
Pas (aey Nabi), sabr karo, Allah ka waada bar-haqq hai, apne kasoor ki maafi chaho aur subah o shaam apne Rubb ki hamd ke saath uski tasbeeh karte raho

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَـٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ ۙ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَـٰلِغِيهِ ۚ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ

translations.text: As for those who, with no authority to do so, dispute God’s messages, there is nothing in their hearts but a thirst for a greatness they will never attain. Seek refuge in God, for He is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.

Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jo log kisi sanad o hujjat ke bagair jo unke paas aayi ho, Allah ki aayat mein jhagade kar rahey hain unke dilon mein kibr (ghamand /pride) bhara hua hai. Magar woh us badayi ko pahunchne waley nahin hain jiska woh ghamand rakhte hain. Bas Allah ki panaah maang lo, woh sabkuch dekhta aur sunta hai

verses.text_uthmani: لَخَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater by far than the creation of mankind, though most people do not know it.
Aasmano aur zameen ka paida karna Insano ko paida karne ki ba-nisbat yaqeenan zyada bada kaam hai, magar aksar log jaante nahin hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَلَا ٱلْمُسِىٓءُ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.text: The blind and the sighted are not equal, just as those who believe and do good works and those who do evil are not equal: how seldom you reflect!
Aur yeh nahin ho sakta ke andha (blind) aur beena (dekhne wala) yaksan ho jaye, aur imandaar o saleh aur badhkaar barabar thehrein. Magar tumlog kam hi kuch samajhte ho

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: The Final Hour is sure to come, without doubt, but most people do not believe.
Yaqeenan qayamat ki ghadi aane waali hai. Uske aane mein koi shakk nahin, magar aksar log nahin maante

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ

translations.text: Your Lord says, ‘Call on Me and I will answer you; those who are too proud to serve Me will enter Hell humiliated.’
Tumhara Rubb kehta hai “ Mujhey pukaro, main tumhari duaein qabool karunga. Jo log ghamand mein aa kar meri ibadat se mooh moadte hain, zaroor woh zaleel o khwar ho kar jahannum mein daakhil hongey”

verses.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ

translations.text: It is God who has given you the night in which to rest and the day in which to see. God is truly bountiful to people, but most people do not give thanks.

Woh Allah hi to hai jisne tumhare liye raat banayi taa-ke tum usmein sukoon haasil karo, Aur din ko roshan kiya. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah logon par bada fazl farmane wala hai magar aksar log shukar ada nahin karte

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَـٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ

translations.text: Such is God your Lord, the Creator of all things: there is no god but Him. How can you be so deluded?
Wahi Allah (jisne tumhare liye yeh kuch kiya hai) tumhara Rubb hai. Har cheez ka khaliq uske siwa koi mabood nahin. Phir tum kidhar se behkaye jaa rahe ho

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ

translations.text: This is how deluded those who deny God’s messages are.
Isi tarah woh sab log behkaye jatey rahey hain jo Allah ki aayat ka inkar karte thay

verses.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ ۖ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: It is God who has given you the earth for a dwelling place and the heavens for a canopy. He shaped you, formed you well, and provided you with good things. Such is God your Lord, so glory be to Him, the Lord of the Worlds.

Woh Allah hi to hai jisne tumhare liye zameen ko jaaye qaraar (dwelling place) banaya aur upar Aasmaan ka gumbadh (canopy) bana diya, jisne tumhari surat banayi aur badi hi umdah banayi. Jisne tumhein paakeeza cheezon ka rizq diya. Wahi Allah (jis ke yeh kaam hai) tumhara Rubb hai, Bay hisaab barakaton wala hai woh qayanaat ka Rubb

verses.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ۗ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: He is the Living One and there is no god but Him, so call on Him, and dedicate your religion entirely to Him. Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
Wahi zinda hai uske siwa koi mabood nahin.Usi ko tum pukaro apne deen ko uske liye khaalis karke. Saari tareef Allah Rabbul aalameen hi ke liye hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ مِن رَّبِّى وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: Say [Prophet], ‘Since clear evidence has come to me from my Lord I am forbidden to serve those you call upon besides God: I am commanded to submit to the Lord of the Worlds.’

(Aey Nabi), In logon se kehdo ke “mujhey to un hastiyon ki ibadat se manah kardiya gaya hai jinhein tum Allah ko chodh kar pukarte ho. (main yeh kaam kaise kar sakta hoon) jabke mere paas mere Rubb ki taraf se bayyinat aa chuki hain. Mujhey hukum diya hai ke main Rubb ul aalameen ke aagey sar-e-tasleem kham kardun.”

verses.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًا ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.text: It is He who created you from dust, then from a drop of fluid, then from a tiny, clinging form, then He brought you forth as infants, then He allowed you to reach maturity, then He let you grow old- though some of you die sooner- and reach your appointed term so that you may reflect.

Wahi to hai jisne tumko mitti se paida kiya, phir nutfey se, phir khoon ke lothdey se, phir woh tumhein bachhe ki shakal mein nilkalta hai, phir tumhein badhata hai taake tum apni poori taaqat ko pahunch jao, phir aur badhata hai taa-ke tum budhape ko pahuncho aur tum mein se koi pehle hi wapas bula liya jaata hai. Yeh sab kuch is liye kiya jaata hai taa-ke tum apne muqarrar waqt tak pahunch jao, Aur is liye ke tum haqeeqat ko samjho

verses.text_uthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

translations.text: It is He who gives life and death, and when He ordains a thing, He says only ‘Be’ and it is.
Wahi hai zindagi denay wala, aur wahi maut denay wala hai. Woh jis baat ka bhi faisla karta hai, bas ek hukum deta hai ke woh ho jaye aur woh jo jaati hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَـٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ

translations.text: [Prophet], do you see how deluded those who dispute God’s messages are-
Tumne dekha un logon ko jo Allah ki aayaat mein jhagade karte hain, kahan se woh phiraye jaa rahe hain

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَا ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: those who reject the Scripture and the messages We have sent through Our messengers? They will find out
Yeh log jo is kitaab ko aur un saari kitabon ko jhutlate hain jo humne apne Rasoolon ke saath bheji thi anqareeb unhein maaloom ho jayega

verses.text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱلْأَغْلَـٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ وَٱلسَّلَـٰسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ

translations.text: when, with iron collars and chains around their necks, they are dragged
Jab tauq (fetters) unki gardano mein hongey, aur zanjeerein, jinse pakad kar

verses.text_uthmani: فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ

translations.text: into scalding water, and then burned in the Fire,
Woh khaulte huey pani ki taraf kheenchey jayenge aur phir dozakh ki aag mein jhonk diye jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ

translations.text: and asked, ‘Where now are those you called upon
Phir unse pucha jayega ke ab kahan hai Allah ke siwa woh dusre khuda jinko tum shareek karte thay

verses.text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

translations.text: besides God?’ They will say, ‘They have abandoned us: those we called upon before were really nothing at all.’ ‘This is how God lets disbelievers go astray,
Woh jawab denge “khoye gaye woh humse, balke hum issey pehle kisi cheez ko na pukarte thay”. Is tarah Allah kaafiron ka gumraah hona mutahaqqiq (to stumble in error) kardega

verses.text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ

translations.text: all because on earth you revelled in untruth and ran wild.
Unse kaha jayega “yeh tumhara anjaam is liye hua hai ke tum zameen mein gair haqq par magan thay aur phir us par itratay thay

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

translations.text: Enter the gates of Hell, there to remain- an evil home for the arrogant.’
Ab jao, Jahannum ke darwazon mein daakhil ho jao hamesha tumko wahin rehna hai, bahut hi bura thikana hai mutakabbirin (proud) ka”

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۚ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

translations.text: So be patient [Prophet], for God’s promise is sure: whether We show you part of what We have promised them in this life or whether We take your soul back to Us first, it is to Us that they will be returned.

Pas aey Nabi, sabr karo Allah ka wada barhaqq hai. Ab khwa hum tumhare saamne hi inko un buray nataij ka koi hissa dikha dein jinse hum inhein dara rahey hain, ya (ussey pehle) tumhein duniya se utha lein, palat kar aana to inhein hamari hi taraf hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ

translations.text: We have sent other messengers before you- some We have mentioned to you and some We have not- and no messenger could bring about a sign except with God’s permission. When [the Day] God ordained comes, just judgement will be passed between them: there and then, those who followed falsehood will be lost.

Aey Nabi, tumse pehle hum bahut se Rasool bhej chuke hain jinmein se baaz ke haalat humne tumko bataye hain aur baaz ke nahin bataye. Kisi Rasool ki bhi yeh taaqat na thi ke Allah ke izan ke bagair khud koi nishani le aata. Phir jab Allah ka hukum aa gaya to haqq ke mutabiq faisla kardiya gaya aur us waqt galat-kaar log khasare (loss) mein padh gaye

verses.text_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمَ لِتَرْكَبُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.text: It is God who provides livestock for you, some for riding and some for your food;
Allah hi ne tumhare liye yeh maweshi janwar banaye hain taa-ke in mein se kisi par tum sawar ho aur kisi ka gosht khao

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

translations.text: you have other benefits in them too. You can reach any destination you wish on them: they carry you, as ships carry you [on the sea].

Inke andar tumhare liye aur bhi bahut se munafe (faidey) hain, woh is kaam bhi aate hain ke tumhare dilon mein jahan jaane ki haajat ho wahan tum unpar pahunch sako, unpar bhi aur kashtiyon par bhi tum sawar kiye jatey ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ فَأَىَّ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ

translations.text: He shows you His signs: which of God’s signs do you still ignore?
Allah apni yeh nishaniyan tumhein dikha raha hai, Aakhir tum uski kin kin nishaniyon ka inkar karogey

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.text: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how those who lived before them met their end? They were more numerous than them, stronger than them, and made a more impressive mark on the land, yet what they achieved was of no use to them at all.

Phir kya yeh zameen mein chaley phirey nahin hain ke inko un logon ka anjaam nazar aata jo insey pehle guzar chuke hain? Woh insey taadaad mein zyada thay, inse badhkar taaqatwar thay, aur zameen mein insey zyada shaandaar aasaar chodh gaye hain.Jo kuch kamayi unhon ne ki thi aakhir woh unke kisi kaam aayi

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

translations.text: When messengers came to them with clear signs, they revelled in the knowledge they had, and so they were engulfed by the very punishment they mocked:
Jab unke Rasool unke paas bayyinaat (clear proofs) lekar aaye to woh usi ilm mein magan rahey jo unke apne paas tha, aur phir usi cheez ke phair mein aa gaye jiska woh mazak udate thay

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشْرِكِينَ

translations.text: when they saw Our punishment, they said, ‘We believe in God alone; we reject any partner we ascribed to Him,’
Jab unhon ne hamara azaab dekh liya to pukar utthey ke humne maan liya Allah wahdahu laa shareek ko aur hum inkar karte hain un sab maaboodon ka jinhein hum shareek thehrate thay

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَـٰنُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا ۖ سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: but believing after seeing Our punishment did not benefit them at all- this has always been God’s way of dealing with His creatures- there and then the disbelievers were lost.

Magar hamara azaab dekh lene ke baad unka imaan unke liye kuch bhi naafeh (faydamand) na ho sakta tha, kyunke yahi Allah ka muqarrar zaabta hai jo hamesha uske bandon mein jaari raha hai, aur us waqt kaafir log khasarey (nuksan) mein padh gaye
